transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you’re here. What brings you in today?

I guess... well, my husband wanted me to come. Him and the people at the warehouse, they keep acting like I'm crazy. But I'm not. I know they've been watching my moves... changing the pallet counts on me. Just to keep me from getting that supervisor spot.
Have you been feeling unusually high or irritable for a period of time?

I don't know about "high." I just... some days I'm just fired up, you know? Like I can get everything done and nobody can slow me down. But then... my husband, he'll ask me some little thing. Like about the kids, or when I'm working next, and I just... I snap at him. It feels like he's always trying to manage me.
Have you had a period when you felt abnormally excited or unusually full of energy?

I guess so. Sometimes I just... have a lot of energy. Like, even after a full shift at the warehouse, I'll go to the boxing gym. And then I come home and clean the whole kitchen. I'll just start writing out lists for the next day. I don't really feel like sitting down.
Have you had a period of several days when you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt full of energy?

I mean... I guess there have been times like that. Weeks, sometimes. I'll sleep... maybe three hours. I'll wake up before my alarm even goes off. And I just... I don't feel like I need any more rest. I just get up and get moving.
Have you had a period of at least one week when you felt unusually energized or irritable most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah... I guess. If you look at this whole stretch of time I've been dealing with things... more than half of it has been those fired-up periods. Where I barely sleep and just take on way too much. And... yeah, I get pretty mad if anyone tries to slow me down. It definitely goes on for a week... or longer.
Have you ever had the belief that people were watching or sabotaging you even when your energy and mood were otherwise normal?

Yeah... I guess so. Even when things were quieter for a few weeks... like, when I was sleeping okay and not rushing around everywhere... I still heard that voice. Telling me to check things. And... I knew people were messing with my pallet counts at work. Changing them on purpose.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you were not having any manic or depressed symptoms but you were still hearing voices or feeling that people were sabotaging you?

Yeah... like I was just saying. It was a few weeks. Things were quiet, and I was sleeping closer to normal... not racing around as much. But... I still heard the voice telling me to check things. And I still knew they were changing my pallet counts against me.
During those times when your sleep and energy were back to normal, did the voices or the feeling that people were sabotaging you last for at least two weeks?
Yeah... I just said that. It was a few weeks. I was sleeping okay, not doing too much... but the voice was still there. And the counts were still wrong.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt very down or lost interest in things nearly every day?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really felt like that.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when the voices or beliefs were still there, but you were not having any manic or depressed symptoms?

I... I feel like I just answered this. Yes. Like I said... there was a quiet few weeks. I was sleeping more normally, not racing around. But... I still heard the voice telling me to check things. And I still knew they were changing the pallet counts on me. I don't really know how else to explain it.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when the voices or beliefs were still there, but you were not having any manic or depressed symptoms?
I just... I just said yes to that. A minute ago. The quiet few weeks. I don't know what else you want me to say about it.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or strongly believing people were sabotaging you, but you were not having any manic symptoms at all?

I... I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing. I already told you. Yes. There were a few weeks where I was sleeping okay... not feeling all sped up. But the voice was still there. And I still knew they were messing with the pallets. I don't... I don't have anything else to add to that.
When you hear the voice or feel that people are sabotaging you, are those experiences ever present at the same time as your high-energy or irritable periods?

Yeah. Um... like those weeks when I was hardly sleeping at all. I was pushing extra shifts, doing boxing, and helping out with church work... I was still hearing that man's voice then. And I was still sure the people at the warehouse were setting me up. So... yeah.
Have you ever had any hallucinations or fixed beliefs that lasted for at least two weeks when you were not having any manic or depressive symptoms at all?

I... I really don't get why you keep asking me this. I said yes. Even when I had a quieter few weeks... when I was sleeping normal and not racing around... I don't know why we keep going in circles. I don't have anything else to add to it.
